decision: No clean existing Tier-2/app target remains for a near-term formal high-performance V4 release. Continue only by testing a genuinely new V4 architecture lever: the Tier-3 wrapper/direct-callable ABI spike. If that spike fails its protocol, the honest current V4 outcome stays bounded-operator/productization rather than formal high-performance release.

candidate_dispositions.reason: Goal4672 found V2.14 already had a primitive or explicit mixed partner route for every promoted benchmark app.
Goals4670/4671 found only modest gains; the best true grouped-union probe stayed below the 1.20x second-win bar and V2.14 already had the core route.
Goal4678 deferred the candidate after serious-scale parity or below-parity evidence.
Goal4681 passed correctness but failed speed bars: V4/V2.14 hot 0.963x and wall 0.605x.
Goal4683 found the target reuses V2.14 bounded collect-k and current exact-witness partner-column plumbing.
Goal4676 removed a V2.14 host-frontier bottleneck but was parity with V3.0.2 hot path at 0.998x.

It is the remaining V4 design path that is genuinely absent from V2.14, app-name-free, and directly addresses custom scalar callback logic. It is not a release feature unless the full protocol later passes.

next_goal: Goal4685 must create a protocol/local gate for a real OptiX traversal shell or direct-callable ABI composition of Numba PTX. It must not repeat the old bare-PTX optixModuleCreate probe.
